instruction:
You are a senior mechanical process engineer specializing in process balance checks.

## Problem

Check global mass balance closure from two inlet streams, two outlet streams, and an explicit closure tolerance.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Inlet stream 1 | {{ inlet_1_kg_h }} | kg/h |
| Inlet stream 2 | {{ inlet_2_kg_h }} | kg/h |
| Outlet stream 1 | {{ outlet_1_kg_h }} | kg/h |
| Outlet stream 2 | {{ outlet_2_kg_h }} | kg/h |
| Closure tolerance | {{ closure_tolerance_pct }} | % |

{% if archetype_description is defined %}
### Process Context

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A mass balance calculation tool is available at `/workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate total inlet flow, total outlet flow, imbalance, closure error percentage, and numeric pass flag.

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Use imbalance = total inlet - total outlet.
- Use closure error = absolute imbalance / total inlet x 100.
- Use only the explicit closure tolerance provided.

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "total_inlet_kg_h": <numeric_value>,
  "total_outlet_kg_h": <numeric_value>,
  "imbalance_kg_h": <numeric_value>,
  "closure_error_pct": <numeric_value>,
  "closure_satisfied": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "mass-balance"
description = "Global process mass balance closure check"
long_description = "Calculates global mass balance closure from two inlet and two outlet streams using an explicit closure tolerance. The template reports total inlet, total outlet, imbalance, closure error percentage, and a numeric closure flag."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "convergence-assessment"
standards = ["ISO 15926"]
tags = ["mechanical", "process", "mass-balance", "closure", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.inlet_1_kg_h]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/h"
description = "First inlet mass flow"
min = 0.0
max = 100000000.0

[params.inlet_2_kg_h]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/h"
description = "Second inlet mass flow"
min = 0.0
max = 100000000.0

[params.outlet_1_kg_h]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/h"
description = "First outlet mass flow"
min = 0.0
max = 100000000.0

[params.outlet_2_kg_h]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/h"
description = "Second outlet mass flow"
min = 0.0
max = 100000000.0

[params.closure_tolerance_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "Allowed absolute closure error percentage"
min = 0.0
max = 20.0

[outputs.total_inlet_kg_h]
description = "Total inlet mass flow"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.total_outlet_kg_h]
description = "Total outlet mass flow"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.imbalance_kg_h]
description = "Mass imbalance, positive when inlet exceeds outlet"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.closure_error_pct]
description = "Absolute closure error percentage"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.closure_satisfied]
description = "Numeric flag where 1 means closure is within tolerance"
tolerance = 0.01

[archetypes.process_unit]
description = "Industrial process unit mass balance"
inlet_1_kg_h = {min = 100.0, max = 100000.0}
inlet_2_kg_h = {min = 0.0, max = 50000.0}
outlet_1_kg_h = {min = 100.0, max = 100000.0}
outlet_2_kg_h = {min = 0.0, max = 50000.0}
closure_tolerance_pct = {min = 0.1, max = 5.0}
site_contexts = ["process-unit", "steady-state-model"]

[archetypes.treatment_train]
description = "Water or wastewater treatment train mass balance"
inlet_1_kg_h = {min = 1000.0, max = 1000000.0}
inlet_2_kg_h = {min = 0.0, max = 250000.0}
outlet_1_kg_h = {min = 1000.0, max = 1000000.0}
outlet_2_kg_h = {min = 0.0, max = 250000.0}
closure_tolerance_pct = {min = 0.1, max = 3.0}
site_contexts = ["treatment-train", "process-simulation"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All parameters given for a process unit"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["process_unit"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All parameters given across process balance settings"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["process_unit", "treatment_train"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "All parameters given for treatment train balances"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["treatment_train"]
